description: Returns the steps and the copy-paste code that checks new signups with SignupBouncer in one stack: supabase (a hook, no code), fetch (any TypeScript server), nextjs, express, hono, python, firebase or better-auth. Use it when the user is building or changing a signup, register or auth flow. The code reads the API key from SIGNUPBOUNCER_API_KEY. The call has a 1.5-second limit, and any failure lets the signup through.

stack.description: The user's backend or auth stack.

name: integration_guide
